'''Akmalla''' was a port town on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was situated close to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].<ref name="Cat and Mouse" /> During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|171|Jokot}}</ref> the run-down [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] [[The White Door]] operated in the town.<ref name="Cat and Mouse" />
